decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed alterations to the existing shop to provide a separate access to the first floor flat is in keeping with the aesthetic appearance of the terrace building and the character of the St John's Road street scene and will not have any adverse affects on the vitality and viability of the minor shopping centre. The proposal is compliant with Policy S.3.1 (New Retail Development), Policy S.4.2 (Shop Front Design) and Policy S.2.1 (Non-retail uses in Minor Neighbourhood Centres and Key Local Parades) of the Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 5 - Informative: The applicant is advised that the opportunity should be taken to create a level access to the shop to meet the requirements for accessible premises.
description: Alterations to existing shopfront to provide a separate access to self contained first floor flat.
